description: Search Westminster written ministerial statements by text, exact UIN, minister, House, answering body and date made. Search returns plain-text previews; retrieve mode=detail with a returned statementId for the complete HTML. A UIN such as HLWS419 is reused across sessions: narrow it with madeFrom/madeTo. A UIN is not a statementId. Search covers all sessions. A CorrectedAnswer link carries a written-question questionId for ukparl_search_questions mode=detail. Follow collection cursors unchanged; use contentCursor for lossless oversized statements.

answeringBodyIds.description: Up to 20 answering-body IDs resolved through ukparl_lookup_reference, matching any; search only.

contentCursor.description: Opaque lossless content continuation for this same selection.

cursor.description: Opaque search continuation; repeat unchanged filters.

limit.description: Search page size, default 10, cap 100; larger safe integers are capped. Omit in detail.

madeFrom.description: Inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD of the date made; search only.

madeTo.description: Inclusive end YYYY-MM-DD of the date made; search only.

memberId.description: Members API ID of the minister making the statement; search only.

mode.description: Search previews or retrieve one complete statement.

query.description: Statement title or text terms; search only.

statementId.description: Positive decimal statement ID required in detail; UIN is not this ID.

uin.description: Exact statement UIN, such as HLWS419 or HCWS416, case-insensitive. Search only; combine with madeFrom/madeTo to narrow reused UINs.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `http_invalid_params`: The official API returned HTTP 400 for this request. `http_unauthorized`: The official public API returned HTTP 401. `http_forbidden`: The official public API returned HTTP 402 or 403. `http_conflict`: The official API returned HTTP 409, 423 or 424. `http_rate_limited`: The official API returned HTTP 429 after bounded retry handling. `http_invalid_request`: The official API returned an unexpected redirect or another unsupported HTTP client response. `http_server_error`: The official API returned an HTTP 5xx server error. `call_deadline_exceeded`: The 45-second call deadline elapsed before the official API answered. `queue_full`: A selected Questions or Members origin request queue is full. `invalid_mode_arguments`: Required detail ID is missing or fields conflict with the selected mode. `invalid_date_range`: Calendar dates are invalid or reversed. `unknown_reference_id`: The complete answering-body reference excludes a supplied ID. `invalid_cursor`: Collection or content cursor is malformed or bound to another selection. `source_changed`: Selected content changed during retrieval. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
